caption: The video captures an outdoor soccer training ground on artificial turf, framed by nested white goals and a tall net backdrop. A white-and-gold ball rests in the immediate foreground while a yellow ball bounces and gradually settles near the small goal. At the start, a player in black sprints out of frame to the right, leaving the field momentarily empty of nearby action. The framing eases back slightly, keeping the foreground ball in view on the right. After a pause, a second player in black enters from the right and approaches the white-and-gold ball. The player's foot connects with the ball, sending it airborne toward the large goal. The kicked ball travels through the air, shrinking against the net as the player runs forward after it. A red-clad player and a distant white ball remain still throughout the excerpt.
